resources.string:
Higher priorities place sources higher in the source selection. The video priority is the sum of the source priority and quality priority.

For example, source priority 3 plus quality priority 7 gives video priority 10.

Playback starts when collection finishes, you press Skip Loading, or the configured Auto-start after sources loaded count is reached (default: 50; 0 waits for all). Priorities do not automatically skip collection. Early playback leaves remaining sources and subtitles loading in the background. Your saved source preference and profile priorities still determine selection; hidden sources stay hidden.
